baseline.scope: New world profile only. Existing quality/prototype contracts, fixtures and saves are immutable recovery baselines. Negative r2 feedback concerns entry/shop interaction; full-night/combat human results are not inferred.

rules: Required cases must each execute checks>0 and pass; missing/duplicate/unknown/skipped/zero/crash/timeout/nonzero exit fail.
WS07/WSH cannot appear as automatic passed cases. Keep prototype and quality-slice regression suites separate; unknown world-slice must fail until implemented.
New Main, Session default, launcher and save/load defaults select this profile together; no hidden opt-in mode.
Use an independent user-data root AND new path. Never scan/read/migrate/overwrite active r2, rain-night or three-day main/bak. Explicitly supplied old/wrong-profile files fail unchanged.
Bad JSON may recover a valid same-profile/same-version backup; identity/version/map mismatch fails without silent fallback/new game. Unknown fields cannot bypass UID/economy validation.

camera.follow: center on authoritative player foot, clamp to region bounds; immediate follow with optional render-only interpolation <= one physics step
camera.scale: nearest-neighbor; world_view fills available game surface at reference aspect, letterbox rather than alter physics; UI/touch controls outside or at safe edges of that surface
camera.resize_rule: do not rescale coordinates/speed/radius or teleport player; all interactable targets reachable via movement even when off camera

rules: Normalize diagonals, finite axes [-1,1], reject invalid values atomically. Swept circle vs fixed rectangles with slide, including corners; no teleport through collision on long delta.
Store last nonzero direction as nw/ne/sw/se; idle retains facing. Use four existing walk sprites while moving, not a static hero with scrolling background.
World collision/player position belong to core. UI Camera2D, sprite, carry icon and prompts consume view; UI physics/probe cannot independently authorize movement or transactions.
An interaction requires same region, distance<=56 to explicit anchor AND unobstructed segment to anchor; nearest eligible anchor then stable id wins F selection. Press F turns actor toward target.
Every action rechecks range/phase/UID on execution; clicked offscreen buttons do not authorize remote actions. Boundary =56 succeeds, >56 fails.

world_input.effect: Set held movement only; advance is sole time progression. Clear on focus loss/modal/load/region transition.

world_interact.effect: One atomic spatial/economic transaction; all existing request_id duplicate/conflict guarantees apply. Target/action must be offered and revalidated; paused allows only book planning/purchase/save, no take/put/cook/serve/enter.

take.rule: bag at pantry or ready/station_input at prep → carried; station_input may be recovered only with no active job. Core offers deterministic suggested_uids for planned bundle or ready output. No ingredient/dish mixing, no hidden copies.

put.rule: pantry→bag; prep accepts ingredients→station_input; pass accepts dishes→shelf subject to menu slots. All-or-nothing. Putting down never sells; no arbitrary floor drop is required.

cook.rule: Requires exact ingredients already at station, free job/output space and installed device for stew. Consume input UIDs/cost once, allocate actual cooking output UIDs, finish to ready after2000ms; no instant panel craft.

serve.rule: Match that exact instance to that seat/customer budget and demand; reserve same UID/price/cost for ordinary3000ms delivery; stop patience. Only completion removes UID/credits cash; repeat cannot pay twice.

plan.rule: Set next batch plan, default floating_pie×3; no ingredients moved/created. Book is optional for repeating plan; F at pantry/prep performs physical steps without reopening it.

payload.item_ids: unique dish ids, max2 or3 with shelf

menu.rule: Declare offered dishes/order and price; does not move inventory. Set in preparation/intermission, actual matching still requires carried/shelf UIDs.

buy.rule: preparation/intermission; existing prices/cash/supply guards, purchases delivered to pantry bag and visible there; no compulsory per-unit cargo trips.

recycle.rule: preparation/intermission, only bag instances; preserve rare4/8, device18, no sale of carried/loaded/cooking/reserved UID.

recover.rule: Existing once/day12 rescue, no dish income; not required by normal route tests.

open_shop.rule: preparation→trading wave1; no modal. Bell/door light and approaching real guest show result.

start_wave.rule: intermission only; no re-roll/budget or daily reset.

upgrade.rule: settled; costs110 each, field_kit income gate24, no hard exclusivity; activation next_day.

next_day.rule: settled→preparation; preserve inventory/positions/upgrades, generate next queues once; no real-time delay.

enter.rule: shop↔lane requires valid portal and no modal; garden additionally preparation, empty hands, no active cooking/reservations and unused expedition attempt. Atomically preserve return anchor and start real existing expedition. No menu teleport.

equip_weapon.rule: preparation, existing ownership guard; gear tab in same short book.

consume.rule: preparation, actual bag dish and existing exclusive next-expedition meal object/UID; no sale income.

install.rule: preparation/intermission, no active job, existing one-device capacity; install same UID.

uninstall.rule: preparation/intermission, no active job or pot delivery; installed→bag, held portions cool, intrinsic tags retained.

blocked_bypasses: In world profile reject direct craft/display/undisplay/fulfill/start_expedition/finish_shopping and remote economic commands that bypass world_interact spatial guards; internal helpers are not public shortcuts.
Only ordinary inventory listing is global. Purchase, plan, menu and upgrades require their nearby world object even inside a book; opening a book clears movement and pauses clocks.
api.tick_ownership: Main advances non-expedition world exactly once; existing expedition panel advances only phase=expedition. Session rejects world_input there; world jobs/time freeze during expedition. Never let both panels advance same interval.

state.notation: Required public fields, JSON integer values excluding bool; finite numbers only. Existing ledger/RNG/requests preserved. Arrays are authoritative UID references, not secondary inventory copies.

world.region_id: shop|lane (retained lane return anchor while phase=expedition)

view_extensions.world: deep-copy authoritative world incl positions/carry/job/customer state
view_extensions.world.geometry: active region {width,height,colliders,objects,portals} matching fixture revision; view-only enrichment, not duplicated mutable save data. Runtime may bake exact checked layout into core; UI reads core geometry, never its own collision copy.

invariants: An item UID is in exactly one location; every carried/station/job/reservation reference resolves uniquely and contributes to capacity80; consumed ingredients leave items once, cooking outputs preserve exact cost basis.
No new wallet or parallel simulated orders. service.orders/reservations/sales are existing economic facts extended by spatial customer links. No visual sale before authoritative event.
Invalid action, stale target, wrong UID, remote distance, duplicate/conflicting request or interrupted save cannot duplicate cooking output, pickup or income.

Save full region/position/facing/carry/stations/jobs/customer paths/orders/patience/delivery/RNG/held food/return anchor and once-only flags. Load clears held input, not progress; pause/offline time never advances.

Manual serve and automatic floating/pot scheduling create reservations only; reuse/extract the existing _deliver atomic commit as the sole UID removal/cash/order-completion entry. Never add cash in world_interact or UI.

loop.phase_rules: No separate shopping phase in world profile. First boot preparation with known recipe plan. World movement/take/put allowed in all business phases; cooking allowed preparation/trading/intermission. Planning/menu/vendor only preparation/intermission. Three waves retain real intermission. Legacy/quality phase rules remain unchanged.

starter.source: One-time inherited pantry, cost0 ledger entries, never renewed by save/next_day

loop.first_minutes: No opening modal: movement glyph by actor → nearest pantry tray icon → loaded table/stirring job → ready dish → door bell/guest bubble → carried handover OR pass floating flight → customer reaction and actual cash. One visible next hint follows persisted intro_flags, freely skippable; time goals are observations, not forced waits.

cooking.completion_rule: On cook-start consume input UIDs and create cooking output UIDs with per-recipe cost, prepared_wave_id=null. At ready transition stamp current wave if trading, next_wave_id if preparation/intermission, otherwise last wave. No reheat of already-ready/cooled dishes. Jobs continue in nonpaused intermission even after service wave ends.
cooking.cancellation: Before cook, take loaded ingredients back using original UIDs. After cook starts there is no cancel/refund; the2s job may pause/save and produces once. In-flight service likewise cannot cancel/refund or be reselected; completion owns the one payment.

service.rule: Customer walks to its assigned seat before patience starts; actual waiting/reserved order owns bubble and reaction. Channels reserve only arrived customers. Shelf dispatch auto; direct carried handover ordinary. No elapsed minimum wave; finish after orders processed and reservations empty. Floating flights/held pot portions visibly correspond to actual UIDs.

routes: quick_service: take a recipe bundle, batch bake, carry to pass once; fresh pies fly two at a time. Carryover loses speed, encourages a small fresh batch at next break.
hot_meals: installed cauldron batch, stock up to3 warm portions across waves, serve seated hearty/warm demand; cold overflow remains hearty. Preserve intrinsic tags and UID temperatures.

field_kit.effect: Existing fan_wand next morning, real garden route/combat use

shelf.effect: Third menu slot PLUS station-ready→pass automatic relay next morning, max3 dishes per transfer; no ingredient creation or cash until actual delivery

growth.relay: Automatic transfer checks free pass menu capacity/UID ownership; batches at next fixed step, blocked output stays ready. Pause/save never repeats. Compare same inputs before/after upgrade: fewer manual dish carry trips, same recipe/UID/cost integrity.

loop.economy: Reuse existing five recipes/catalog/base prices/rain25%/rare resale/recovery/atomic ledger. Stable four-ingredient supply12..14 per night, buy in preparation/intermission. New wave counts/starter/relay are world-only initial values and must be simulated; old Q05 balance claims do not transfer. First night each normal route can afford at least one choice and basic next-night cooking without recovery; investigate domination/softlocks before expansion.

expedition.rule: Reuse real E02 movement/combat/drops, initial bolt/dodge/gust and existing meal object. Entry from lane only, return to saved lane gate anchor, collected UIDs enter pantry bag once. No new combat map/skill tree.

loop.intro_flags: moved requires actual traveled distance>=32; took/loaded/cooked/served advance only on real take/put/completion/paid-delivery events; no guide step grants progress or items.

rules: F/A/touch are rising-edge intents, no key-repeat production; held movement sampled to same world_input core. No click-to-teleport or direct button signal in runtime tests.
Books consume input and clear movement; B/Esc closes book, Start pauses. Touch cancel/focus loss releases all axes.
Combat keeps existing WASD movement/arrows aim, J/Space cast, K/Shift dodge, E/L gust and A/B/X pad; F is not gust. Only active world/battle layer handles events.

integration.core_owner: core implementation: game/core/world_night_session.gd + GameSession explicit profile routing + optional local world_model.gd geometry helper + tests/core/world_session_cases.gd and runner; owns UID references, position, transactions and save validation.
integration.ui_owner: UI implementation: scenes/main.tscn + scenes/ui/world_play.tscn/game/ui/world_play.gd, camera/actor/prompts/input/books/flight feedback; consume production view, no fake core or collision source.
integration.expedition_owner: existing expedition paths/scene and input routing, return hook only as needed; reuse unchanged model contract.
integration.art: Reuse existing walk NW/NE/SW/SE, floor_wood/floor_stone, stove/prep_table/dining_table/serving_counter and other current sprites; pivot/depth anchored at feet. No bulk full-world art prerequisite.
integration.dependencies: H03/root registers actual new task IDs/paths and dispatches. Core publishes view/actions→UI binds→runtime same candidate; motion-only probe may use same geometry but cannot count as economy completion. One combined implementation review, not per-SHA design review.

acceptance.claim: 店铺/巷道中角色真实移动、碰撞与镜头跟随。
pass_conditions: 全部固定地图出生点/工作点/四座位/门口可达；行走改变核心位置与方向，镜头跨过参考视野且边界不露外部。
墙、桌、柜的正反例/斜角/长delta不穿透；三输入归一同速，释放/失焦/暂停不残留移动。

acceptance.claim: 空间近邻与携带物约束真实授权事务。
pass_conditions: 拿食材→放工作台→拿成菜→交付均移动同UID；carry容量12、位置互斥、远距/隔墙/错误目标/非法UID/重复F/请求冲突原子拒绝。
屏幕按钮、直接旧craft/display/fulfill与远程采购不能绕开空间guard；同区距离边界56内外均验证。

acceptance.claim: 批量魔法料理和两路线在世界中可操作。
pass_conditions: 已知五配方1/3/6批量，真实原料在台才可做，成本进实际cooking/readyUID；2秒工作可边走边进行，暂停/恢复不复制。
新制浮空双通道与锅3份跨波保温各有正常/冷余货反例，视觉对应真实状态，不是改标签或仅开面板。

acceptance.claim: 一位真实客人的到店、需求、菜与收入相连。
pass_conditions: 从正常初始档经世界动作给首客实际交付；到达→等待→预留→进食反应→离开与order绑定。
先放柜台不收钱；交付才有账本收入，同UID/订单至多一次；错菜/预算不足/未到达/超时/在途保存有反例。

acceptance.claim: 完整一晚与次晨成长保留可玩的选择。
pass_conditions: 五seed×两路线×standard/premium走正常经营三波到次晨，不靠恢复/作弊、无负现金与软锁；首晚能买至少一个选择并做下一晚基础料理。
shelf升级后同批次完成更少手搬趟数且UID/成本不变；field_kit次晨真实装备入菇圃改变打法；两项不得靠强制互斥造取舍。
从店门步行到巷道供应商/菇圃，真实战斗掉落回库一次；不探索分支也可经营，地点切换不刷新天/次数。

acceptance.claim: 新世界完整保存且旧r2与旧profile均不受影响。
pass_conditions: 在携料、台内、烹饪、成菜、预留、客人途中、门口/巷道、战斗返程、升级后分别保存重启，与同输入连续分支等价。
旧r2活跃档与备份、rain-night/三日档及旧包前后哈希不变；新Main默认新profile，错版本/地图/坏档边界有实际读写证据。
暂停/失焦/模态/离线不推进或残留输入，request/transaction/RNG与经济守恒保持。

acceptance.claim: 真实三输入首段可玩并覆盖完整夜。
pass_conditions: 同候选真实InputEvent鼠键/合成触屏/手柄首段能走、拿、做、给实际客人得收入；首次收入观察目标3–5分钟，不用直接core/按钮signal冒充。
至少同候选三输入各一晚和次晨成长，真实全屏/窄屏、镜头边缘提示/携带图标/客人需求无遮挡，独立进程恢复，原始日志/截图/SHA齐全。
移动probe、build或旧Q回归都不能替代本项；合成输入不等于实体设备验收。

acceptance.claim: 真人入口失败得到新的实际体验检验。
pass_conditions: 记录r2已明确的负面入口反馈；新候选由用户或咩咩自由操作，观察首分钟能否发现移动与近邻动作、3–5分钟是否理解做菜给客人。
观察两路线、重复搬运负担和次日期待；无人测/只测开头不外推一晚或战斗。仍无聊则失败并收敛修机制，不以自动绿或说明书宣称好玩。
